title: This New AI Model Just Killed Nano Banana 2 #ai #freeonlinetools
description: Luma Labs Luma just launched a model named Uni1 that is truly in a category of its own Its the first AI image model that I personally think beats Nano Banana 2 Thats because its the first ever image model built on Unified Intelligence See every major image model for the last several years has worked with a process called diffusion you start with static and remove noise until the picture appears Uni1 is built differently its a reasoning model that can generate It understands what you are trying to make plans the approach and turns ideas into finished creative work in one continuous flow What stands out is how well it handles structured content for marketers and entrepreneurs Infographic diagrams presentations marketing collateral etc LumaPartnerRoberto Nickson
